items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: He was with Charlie Barnett. We were in there together.

ctx.x: And Charlie Barnett was another guy like that, and I think we mentioned something like this before, that I made a couple of mistakes where it should have been a B flat, and I had a B natural, and one of those things, I said, 'Oh, man, this is wrong, this is dischord.' And Charlie said, 'You remember what you did?' I says, 'Yeah. I made a mistake.' 'Keep it in. Keep it in,' one of those things. He liked weird things like that. Of course, he was a fan, as you know, a great admirer of Duke Ellington. He patterned…
